ns2:section.sectionText: This course introduces students to field experience in internships and service work. Students work through a self-assessment of goals, skills and knowledge, and research internships/service opportunities that match their goals and strengths. In addition to preparing application materials for specific opportunities, students will make a plan on how they can connect their field experience to their academic program through a research project. The course ends with a discussion on developing and applying leadership skills, such as taking initiative and teamwork, during the field experience.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to International Studies or Global Studies major(s).
